title: Borderless weekly payments statement: date headings, subtotals and a week split across the page
row_rules: One row per order. The week-ending date comes from the heading above the order's group; the orders at the top of page 2 still belong to the week that started on page 1. Week headings, week totals, Carried forward, Brought forward and the Total for July 2026 are not rows.
why: The date is not in any row: it is a heading above each week's orders, and the week of 17 July is cut by the page break, so the two orders at the top of page 2 sit under no heading of their own: their week is named only on page 1 (the week totals carry no date). Subtotal, carried-forward and brought-forward lines look like data rows, there are no ruled lines, and long descriptions wrap.
